newsitem.title: ESTONIA: BUSINESS NEWSPAPERS TO LAUNCH BALTIC INDEX.
newsitem.headline: BUSINESS NEWSPAPERS TO LAUNCH BALTIC INDEX.

text.p: The three main business newspapers of Latvia, Estonia and Lithuania are to launch a Baltic share index in May, to reflect changes in the countries' stock markets, Estonian newspaper Aripaev said on Thursday.
The three newspapers, owned by Swedish media group Bonnier, also plan to launch a fund in all Baltic countries, similar to the Aripaev Index Fund launched a month ago, he added.
"The index will give an overall picture not only of Estonia but of the whole Baltic stock market," senior editor Andrus Vaher told Reuters.
"The word 'Baltics' is more familiar to international investors than the three countries separately," he added.
Estonian Aripaev, Latvian Dienas Bizness and Lithuanian Verslo Zinios will choose 10 leading stock market companies with the highest capitalisation from each country for the index.
Aripaev has already launched an Estonian index, which began in April 1995. Since then, it has risen by around eight times.
